history.overview: The Chamber of Frost channels ice‑aligned Discord energy to slow, bind, and crystallize unstable planar flows.

timeline.name: Frost Chamber Carved
timeline.description: Riftseekers carved the chamber into glacial stone to harness elemental cold.

timeline.name: Discord Frost Infusion
timeline.description: Discord energy was bound to crystalline spires, amplifying temporal slowing effects.

timeline.name: Muramite Frost Assaults
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to exploit the chamber’s freezing power to immobilize enemies.

timeline.name: Glacial Binding Rites
timeline.description: Riftseekers conducted rituals that crystallized rift energy for study and containment.
